name: po-o7
prompt:
In server/src/overview.rs, replace the body `todo!("unit o7")` of fn parse_git with the real code. Keep its signature and doc comment exactly. Spec: `output` is a shell job's output: the command's lines, then a last line "exit: N". Find the last line that starts with "exit:"; when there is none or its trimmed number is not "0", return None. Take the other lines before it, trimmed, skipping empty ones: the first is the remote, the second the branch; when either is missing return None. Remove credentials from the remote: when it contains "://" and an '@' appears after the "://" and before the next '/', drop everything between "://" and that '@' including the '@' ("https://kees:tok@host/x.git" -> "https://host/x.git"). An ssh remote like "git@github.com:k/app.git" stays as it is. Return Some((remote, branch)).
Change nothing else in the file; the other functions keep their todo!() until their own job.
